[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Roasted Vegetable Pasta: Features roasted eggplant, zucchini, red bell peppers, and cherry tomatoes tossed with olive oil, garlic, and penne pasta, topped with grated Parmesan and fresh basil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Spinach and Mushroom Cream Sauce Pasta: Made with sautéed mushrooms, garlic, and spinach in heavy cream and grated Parmesan, served with fettuccine or pappardelle.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Grilled Vegetable Pasta: Features grilled zucchini, eggplant, and red bell peppers, tossed with olive oil, garlic, and linguine, with toasted pine nuts and crumbled feta cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Butternut Squash and Sage Pasta: Contains roasted butternut squash, caramelized onions, and sage, tossed with olive oil, garlic, and pappardelle, topped with grated Parmesan and toasted pumpkin seeds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Vegetable Carbonara: A creamy dish with sautéed mushrooms, bell peppers, and onions, tossed with a vegan bacon substitute, tofu, and spaghetti, finished with nutritional yeast.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Lentil and Tomato Pasta: Features red or green lentils cooked with diced tomatoes, onions, and garlic, served with whole wheat spaghetti and parsley.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a simple recipe for homemade pesto sauce with the following ingredients:

[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/3 cup pine nuts (or walnuts or almonds)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese (or vegan Parmesan/nutritional yeast)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2 cloves garlic, peeled and minced  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Salt, to taste
